mug_felix: Inconsistent location. Day 13/14 feedback showed coffee_table_l1, but Day 15 07:34 feedback showed kitchen_table_k1. It moves between the living room and kitchen. Check kitchen_table_k1 for early morning locations, as it was there today.

tablet_felix: Highly inconsistent location. Day 15 feedback showed kitchen_table_k1 at 07:35, coffee_table_l1 at 09:59, and bed_b1 at 21:07. It does not reliably stay in one spot. Check bed_b1 for late-night locations, as it was there today.

charger_felix: Inconsistent location. Previous note to check nightstand_b1 was wrong. Day 15 10:12 feedback showed coffee_table_l1. Check coffee_table_l1 for mid-day locations.

book_felix: Inconsistent location. Previous note to check coffee_table_l1 was wrong. Day 15 11:52 feedback showed coffee_table_l1, but I had guessed couch_l1. Wait, the feedback said it was at coffee_table_l1. My previous note said check coffee_table_l1. Why was I wrong? Ah, I guessed couch_l1. The feedback confirmed coffee_table_l1. So the previous note was correct, but I failed to follow it or the object moved. Actually, looking at the error: I said couch_l1, it was coffee_table_l1. The previous note said "Check coffee_table_l1". So I ignored my own note. Keep the note: Check coffee_table_l1 for mid-day locations.

razor_felix: Inconsistent location. Day 10 feedback confirmed medicine_cabinet_ba1, Day 13 07:18 confirmed bathroom_shelf_ba1, but Day 14 07:00 feedback showed sink_ba_ba1. It moves between shelf, cabinet, and sink. Check sink_ba_ba1 first in the morning, as it was there today.
